definitions.explanation: The chemical processes in the body that convert food into energy and building materials. Commonly discussed in the context of health, dieting, and fitness.

examples.japanese: {代謝|たいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{代謝|たいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧{代謝|たいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that exercising raises your basal metabolism.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧{代謝|たいしゃ} (basal metabolism)
- {新陳|しんちん}{代謝|たいしゃ} (metabolism; turnover, renewal)
- {代謝|たいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to boost metabolism)
- {代謝|たいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ / ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (metabolism drops)

The compound {新陳|しんちん}{代謝|たいしゃ} literally means "old out, new in" and is used both for biological metabolism and figuratively for organizational renewal or generational change.
